actions.text: The man gestures while talking to Celia on the bridge.
Celia turns to face him, raising her robotic hand defensively.
The man stammers and gestures towards her hand.
The man looks down, then admits his fear directly to her.

camera.text: Static medium wide shot of the couple on the canal bridge.

analysis.performance_note: Strong comedic timing and natural chemistry between the actors. The robotic arm prop is handled convincingly.
analysis.summary: A young man and a woman with a robotic arm discuss their passions on a bridge. She accuses him of being freaked out by her hand, and he eventually admits it.
